record.question: Considering the administrative divisions of Mizoram, which of the following statements accurately reflects the relationship between its districts, sadar sub-divisions, civil sub-divisions, and blocks?
options: The number of civil sub-divisions is equal to the total number of districts and sadar sub-divisions combined.
Each district in Mizoram contains at least one sadar sub-division and one civil sub-division, ensuring a balanced administrative structure across all 11 districts.
The number of Blocks is exactly double the combined total of districts and civil sub-divisions.
Mizoram has more civil sub-divisions than sadar sub-divisions, while the number of blocks significantly exceeds the number of districts.
